articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
articles.snippet: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

articles.title: OpenAI Will Pay You Up to $8K to Preach the AI Gospel to Small Businesses
articles.snippet: OpenAI wants local AI evangelists to bring ChatGPT to Main Street. Its new OpenWorks program pays up to $8,000 monthly, provided you can actually help businesses get things done locally.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
articles.snippet: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

articles.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
articles.snippet: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

articles.title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
articles.snippet: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.
